sourceSentence: A written plan can turn vague intentions into clearer action.
sourceQuestion: In general, do you think planning is important?
sourceMeaning: A compact transformation pattern for planning; it makes the benefit concrete.

decision.reason: Vague intentions into clearer action is a fragment of a transformation clause, not a standalone expression. Provisional editorial decision; independent review remains open.

candidateOwner.title: turn good intentions into daily habits
candidateOwner.exactOwnerSourceSentence: A timetable helps turn good intentions into daily habits.
candidateOwner.meaningEn: Translate worthwhile intentions into actions repeated in everyday life.
candidateOwner.grammar: turn good intentions into daily habits; turned/turning; turn X into Y is a productive change pattern, not a guarantee that announcing a plan creates a habit
candidateOwner.boundaryZh: 要有重複行動及可持續安排，不只是決心或一次嘗試；也不由有安排推未來一定從不間斷。
candidateOwner.assessedDecision: The existing listening, scene, contrast, dialogue, and writing all require a small action repeated enough to form or test a daily habit; an announced intention or one planned step is insufficient.

comparison.shared: Both sentences use the productive turn X into Y change construction and move from intention toward action.
comparison.different: Source 3307 says a written plan can make vague intentions lead to clearer action. It neither says the action has happened nor requires daily repetition. Owner 1690 names daily habits as the result and tests repeated practice in all assessed contexts.
comparison.aliasDecision: Do not broaden owner 1690 to this source: matching the full source would require replacing its daily-habit target/result with a generic action endpoint, while its six learner decisions and examples still evaluate repetition.
comparison.standaloneDecision: The source expression is a transparent fragment of turn X into Y, with vague and clearer supplying context. As written it lacks a stable narrower expression and a distinct seven-decision boundary for a separate advanced lesson. A future re-lemma to a conventional action phrase would need source/naturalness and SOP feasibility review; it is not authorized by this evidence.

nearbyOwners.title: backed up by action
nearbyOwners.reason: Requires a practical step already taken to substantiate words or promises; the source only says a plan can clarify future action.

nearbyOwners.title: do not run on good intentions alone
nearbyOwners.reason: Requires practical resources and arrangements for a project to operate; the source is about a written plan clarifying intended action.

nearbyOwners.title: awareness is one thing, and action is another
nearbyOwners.reason: Contrasts recognising a problem with doing something; source expresses a possible transformation from vague intentions into clearer action, not that contrast.

lexicalEvidence.title: Cambridge Dictionary, turn (BECOME)
lexicalEvidence.use: Documents turn something into something as a productive change construction, not a fixed expression with these particular nouns.

lexicalEvidence.title: Cambridge Dictionary, action
lexicalEvidence.use: Lists put something into action as a different expression meaning to begin implementing an idea or plan; it does not make source wording an instance of owner 1690.
